g.text: POL threshold nominal +4.90 V relative CELL0; reverse input remains within comparator common mode

g.desc: POL threshold nominal +4.90 V relative CELL0; reverse input remains within comparator common mode

g.text: at +/-140 V with host alive. Host-off injection through divider needs an explicit clamp/disconnect review.
